description: `[1 2] = 5` assigns to a bare list literal, not a place, raising the runtime's own `ol-not-a-place` (issue #113/#156), mirroring `not-a-place-runtime-literal.expected.json`'s number-literal case. `params.text` carries the FULL target surface text (`[1 2]`), per the full-target-text rule from issue #113/#156. Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why the runtime's copy does not appear beside the check's.
